# Pranshu Rastogi

> Pranshu Rastogi is a DevRel, ecosystem, backend and blockchain engineer. He is Head of Ecosystem & Integrations at Push Chain, has 7+ years in Web3, has given 30+ conference talks, and has led 1,000+ protocol integrations. He is the founder of SPECTER, a post-quantum stealth address protocol for Ethereum and Sui (ETHCC[9] 3rd prize, Founder School Cohort 2). He is open to DevRel, ecosystem, backend and blockchain engineering roles and consulting.

## SPECTER (flagship project)

SPECTER is a post-quantum stealth address protocol for Ethereum and Sui. Tagline: "Privacy that survives quantum computers. Send to anyone. Know no one." A recipient publishes one meta-address linked to an ENS (.eth) or SuiNS (.sui) name. Every sender derives a fresh one-time stealth address per payment, so there is no public recipient trail. Discovery uses ML-KEM-768 (NIST FIPS 203), a lattice-based post-quantum KEM. View tags skip about 99.6% of announcements (80K announcements scanned in about 1.5 s).

- Founder & builder: Pranshu Rastogi
- Recognition: ETHCC[9] 3rd Prize (Stage Pitch); selected for Founder School Cohort 2 (https://founderschool.build); built at ETHGlobal HackMoney 2026
- Stack: Rust, Axum, ML-KEM-768, WebAssembly, TypeScript, React, Vite, viem, ENS, SuiNS, Sui, Yellow Network, IPFS, Docusaurus
- How it works: 1) generate keys, 2) register a meta-address on ENS/SuiNS, 3) send to a name, 4) funds land at an unlinkable stealth address, 5) scan with view tags and claim
- Install the SDK: `npm install @specterpq/sdk`

### SPECTER links

- [Portfolio case study](https://pranshurastogi.com/projects/specter): Screenshots, demo GIF, features and every link in one place

- [API reference](https://docs.specterpq.com/api/introduction/): Hosted REST API
- [@specterpq/sdk on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@specterpq/sdk): Browser-first TypeScript + WASM SDK (Apache-2.0)
- [SDK playground](https://play.specterpq.com): Run key generation, payments and scanning in the browser
- [SDK source](https://github.com/specter-privacy/specter-sdk): specter-privacy/specter-sdk
- [Protocol source](https://github.com/pranshurastogi/SPECTER): Rust backend, web app and docs
- [Pitch deck](https://canva.link/specter-pitch): Vision, market and roadmap
- [Use cases](https://specterpq.com/usecases): Private trading, payroll, tipping, OTC settlement, DAO payouts
- [SPECTER × Yellow Network](https://specterpq.com/yellow): Anonymous state-channel trading
- [Recovery without SPECTER](https://specterpq.com/i-dont-trust-specter): Self-custodial fund recovery that works if SPECTER is offline
- [Insights](https://specterpq.com/insights): Post-quantum and privacy writing

## Other projects

- [VANTA](https://pranshurastogi.com/projects/vanta): Transaction firewall between AI agents and the blockchain. Every proposed transaction is scored by a policy engine and AI risk scanner before execution. Source: https://github.com/pranshurastogi/VANTA
- [AlphIQ](https://pranshurastogi.com/projects/alphiq): Alephium analytics dashboard with real-time stats, wallet profiler, Ralph decoder and gamified quests. Live: https://www.alphiq.xyz
- [AlphIQ Admin Dashboard](https://pranshurastogi.com/projects/alphiq-admin-dashboard): Admin console for AlphIQ analytics and quest creation. Live: https://admin.alphiq.xyz
- [EYI — Earn Your Identity](https://pranshurastogi.com/projects/eyi): Multi-platform decentralized identity (ENS, GitHub, X, Farcaster, Self Protocol). Live: https://eyi-two.vercel.app
- [Bloom Ideas](https://pranshurastogi.com/projects/bloom-ideas): Collaborative idea-sharing platform on Etherlink with NFT rewards for contributors
- [Intellilearn](https://pranshurastogi.com/projects/intellilearn): Gamified Web3 education on Open Campus
